design: All 70 historical misses, fixed order. Fresh independent control/candidate reader and judge for every question, including identical contexts. Alternate arm submission order by cohort index; shared four-request semaphore. One retrieval per arm per cloned immutable pack; no new ingestion. Candidate only changes the temporal provider configuration. Pre-provider control context must equal original GPT benchmark bytes. One authored live preflight before dataset provider requests.
safety: Only question/date/packed evidence enters resolver; only operands and question enter Jev. No reference answer, label, historical answer or judge is supplied. Existing route, arithmetic, local checks, Jev 0.85 and same 3996-token effective ceiling unchanged. Product alignment is excluded. New OpenAI variant must report confirmation_protocol_aligned=false.
failure_policy: Any missing question, backend/provider failure, changed source/package/model, malformed verdict, context mismatch or token violation invalidates that complete stage. Preserve all attempts; no automatic resume/replacement. OpenAI HTTP retry max4 transient statuses, no quota or ambiguous transport retry; one schema repair. Jev unchanged max3 attempts.
statistics: Descriptive paired wins/losses, 10000 bootstrap draws seed20260922 by question and identical full-history cluster, category results, routed/accepted/unchanged subsets. Provider success required for complete claims. No overall500 extrapolation and no default promotion from selected failures.
cost: Record all OpenAI request reservations and reported usage cost; Jev raw usage retained, price unknown. Existing ingestion reused with historical time. Median/p95 retrieval latency, context token count and conflicts/evidence omissions retained.
promotion: Experimental opt-in only unless independent full-cohort and untouched confirmation evidence supports promotion.
